soundAtlas.scene.taipei1109: Taipei 9 Nov: rain + Songshan flights + garbage trucks
soundAtlas.scene.heping1108: Heping, Taichung 8 Nov: Taipower lightning + flights
soundAtlas.scene.taipei1109Reason: Next to a Taipei rain gauge with rain on 9 Nov (Donghu Elementary), on the eastern extension of Songshan's runway (about 5.5 km away); about 20 flights passed within 2.5 km that day.
soundAtlas.scene.heping1108Reason: Near a Taipower lightning strike (3.97 kA) around 10:25 on 8 Nov; the nearest gauge (Nanhu Cirque) recorded 0 mm that day.
soundAtlas.scene.typhoon1024Reason: During Typhoon Champi's outer circulation, the Xiaoyoukeng gauge recorded 46.5 mm in the 14:00 hour on 24 Oct, Taipei's highest hourly rain that day.
